label: Lamassu Hydrolase-Protease system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a defense locus encoding a protease-domain LmuA effector together with a hydrolase-like protein, an SMC-like LmuB sensor, and LmuC.
observations: Paired hydrolase/protease Lamassu architecture; XML requires LmuC, whereas the legacy TSV calls it accessory. No exact enzyme, single-effector sibling, or genotype-call equivalence is proposed.
